# jevmod

> Open-source content moderation powered by Jev (TypeSafe's System One model). One request per batch of messages, a probability per category (spam, scam, harassment, nsfw, offtopic, selfharm, doxxing, minors, and ai_generated as an opt-in experimental one) and per plain-language rule, a policy that turns probabilities into flag/delete/timeout. Python SDK, CLI, HTTP API, MCP server, npm package, and Discord/Telegram/Reddit bots over the same core. MIT.

Key facts: flag-only by default; fails open when Jev is unreachable; about $0.000045 per judged message; probabilities move about plus or minus 0.03 between runs; only message text and channel topic are sent to TypeSafe; the key is `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (keyring, environment or .env, never in code), and without it nothing runs.

How much message text is kept is a setting, not a property of the software: `JEVMOD_KEEP_TEXT_CHARS` is 300 by default, and the container behind jevmod.dev sets it to 0, so that one stores no message text.

## Start here

- [Site for community owners](https://jevmod.dev/): what the hosted Discord bot does, what it never does, plans and the live demo.
- [Site for developers](https://jevmod.dev/developers/): quickstart for CLI, Python, npm, HTTP and MCP, the benchmark table and the cost calculator.
- [Privacy](https://jevmod.dev/privacy/) and [Terms](https://jevmod.dev/terms/): written from the code, with the exact data the hosted bot stores and the Discord permissions it asks for.
- [README](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/README.md): the three doors (community owner, developer, self-host), commands, categories, the red-team scoreboard.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/AGENTS.md): exact API signatures, where things live, tests, coding rules, the integration recipe in short form. Read this if you are an agent.
- [BENCHMARK.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/BENCHMARK.md): jevmod against Llama Guard 3, ShieldGemma and toxic-bert on public datasets, with cost and latency.

## Agent skills and plugin

- [plugin/skills/jevmod-integrate/SKILL.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/plugin/skills/jevmod-integrate/SKILL.md): procedure to add moderation to an existing codebase: pick the surface, store the key, wire the call, add a real test, decision table, gotchas.
- [plugin/skills/jevmod-moderate/SKILL.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/plugin/skills/jevmod-moderate/SKILL.md): screen text, inputs and datasets with `jevmod check` (exit codes, --json) or the MCP tools `moderate` and `categories`.
- [plugin/.mcp.json](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/plugin/.mcp.json): the MCP server registration (`jevmod mcp`, stdio) that the Claude Code plugin installs.
- [plugin/README.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/plugin/README.md): what the plugin contains and how to install it from the marketplace.

## Reference

- [jevmod/categories.json](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/jevmod/categories.json): the questions and true/false criteria asked to Jev for every category; the single source shared by Python, npm and MCP.
- [jevmod/judge.py](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/jevmod/judge.py): the judgment core; its docstring records the red-team findings (dict state, NFKC, character pre-filter, criteria on every question).
- [jevmod/core/policy.py](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/jevmod/core/policy.py): default thresholds and actions, `Policy`, `Decision`, `decide`.
- [jevmod/api/server.py](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/jevmod/api/server.py): HTTP endpoints and request/response models; OpenAPI at /docs when running.
- [jevmod/mcp_server.py](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/jevmod/mcp_server.py): the MCP tools and their signatures.
- [.env.example](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/.env.example): every environment variable each role reads.
- [OpenAPI document](https://jevmod.dev/openapi.json) and [Postman collection](https://jevmod.dev/jevmod.postman_collection.json): the HTTP API, ready to import.
- [Architecture diagram](https://jevmod.dev/diagrams/architecture.svg): what reaches the model and what never does.

## Project

- [PLAN.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/PLAN.md): phases, decisions and the production readiness checklist.
- [tests/data/redteam.csv](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/tests/data/redteam.csv): 98 labelled adversarial messages used as the regression floor.
- [DISCLAIMER.md](https://github.com/ohernandezdev/jevmod/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md): no warranty, no affiliation with TypeSafe, Discord, Telegram or Reddit; the operator owns the actions.
